about.text: Milk or cream concentrated by evaporation to at least 15 % fat and sterilised in the can or bottle, so that it keeps without cooling; the richest grade of condensed milk, sold in Germany for coffee as Kondenssahne or kondensierte Kaffeesahne.

sources.text: The photograph, its author and its licence, from its page.

how.text: The milk or cream is homogenised, boiled down under vacuum, filled into cans or bottles and sterilised there, so it keeps without cooling. Figures come from evaporated milk; this product follows the same route at a higher fat.

sources.text: The table, the facts and the words on how it is made, from these.

steps.note: About half the milk's weight in water is removed.
Disodium phosphate stops coagulation, carrageenan stops settling.
Sterilised in the can or bottle.
